description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: lib/zaq/engine/connect/credential.ex, grant.ex, connect.ex changeset entry points, priv/repo/migrations/*, test/zaq/engine/connect/* schema/migration tests. Read moduledocs before edits. Add personal_credential_policy Ecto.Enum disabled/optional/required with database default disabled, NOT NULL and CHECK. Keep user_level unrelated. SUPERSEDING USER-APPROVED REVISION: remove binding_type and person_id completely from the uncommitted migration, schema, changesets and tests. Reuse owner_type/owner_id with person and resource_type/resource_id with connect_credential. Derive canonical resource_type and resource_id server-side; NULL-safe CHECK enforces resource_id = credential_id::text and existing credential_id FK verifies target. Non-null person owner_id refers to people via schema-qualified grant INSERT/reference-UPDATE SELECT FOR KEY SHARE and reverse people DELETE/ID-UPDATE RESTRICT triggers, only if isolation-safe. Legacy org/user remain compatible; do not add old user/resource references. Canonical person unique index uses credential_id/owner_id across statuses. Canonical org owner_id must be NULL. Partial unique indexes enforce one canonical person grant per credential/person and one canonical org grant per credential, regardless of status. Retain revoked/expired row; reconnection replaces current row. Reject ambiguous canonical user ownership until separately specified; existing user resource grants remain supported. Grant provider/auth_kind/request_format and scopes derive from credential, not client attrs. Determine the smallest explicit canonical credential mode necessary to allow JWT credentials without configuration-level private keys while retaining legacy JWT validation; document that distinction rather than overloading user_level or policy.

Tests to add before implementation: migration on representative existing rows; unchanged legacy issue/list/resolve behavior; policy default/invalid enum; Person referential checks on nonexistent targets, owner/reference updates, parent delete and PK updates; real independent connections in both transaction orders and supported isolation levels, including rollback; NULL global uniqueness; concurrent inserts using independent committed connections; revoked/expired rows still occupy slot; canonical resource equality and NULL bypass rejection, server-derived coordinates, and unchanged legacy resource pairs; authentication fields cannot disagree with configuration; required JWT can store grant-owned key material.

Branches/paths validated: all three auth kinds; org/user legacy; person canonical; absent Person; deleted credential; duplicate statuses; migration retry and rollback constraints with personal data present. Refuse destructive down migration while canonical grants exist rather than silently losing secrets.

Mocking plan: none; real Ecto/PostgreSQL and encryption storage. Race tests use isolated data and explicit cleanup, not shared global sandbox mutation. Dependencies: Repo, migration runner and encryption config existing seams.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/: schema moduledocs/types; docs/services/engine.md storage ownership and compatibility; docs/services/system-config.md distinction between configuration and grant secrets. Done: additive migration, tested rollback policy, no AI/schema consumer changes, no provider-wide uniqueness, >=95% changed application-file coverage.

2026-09-14 integrity gate: PostgreSQL 18.4 independent-connection probe reproduced committed orphan grants for both Person DELETE and primary-key UPDATE under REPEATABLE READ after a grant committed beyond the parent transaction snapshot. READ COMMITTED controls rejected both with 23503. SELECT FOR KEY SHARE does not create a parent tuple version or refresh the reverse snapshot. See docs/services/connect-person-trigger-blocker.md. Current uncommitted FK implementation is preserved pending an approved robust strategy; it is not the approved final architecture. secret_binding remains independent. Issue stays open/in_progress; later lifecycle work is not implemented.

comments.text: Implemented storage-only schema/migration and encrypted change_credential_grant/3 entry point; no canonical mutation API, resolver, AI or Person management changes. Decisions: explicit secret_binding enum defaults configuration; grant mode relaxes only configuration JWT private_key requirement, retaining issuer/key_id/profile/subject checks. Canonical grant auth fields/scopes derive from trusted Credential and secrets never copy from configuration. Legacy listing/resolution/scheduled refresh filter resource lane. Person FK restricts deletion pending zaq-jrg.8. Rollback locks tables and refuses canonical grants or nondefault config. Initial TDD run: 9 expected failures; DB upgrade/down/up, constraints and independent committed race tests implemented. Rollback test moved to committed fixtures because SQL Sandbox auto-rolls back on DDL error; real Migrator test now passes with migration_lock:false (avoids sandbox single-connection lock checkout deadlock). Validation and coverage in progress; issue stays in progress.

Validation complete for working-tree implementation: final mix format and mix q exit 0; Credo checks 1181 source files with no issues. Final focused MIX_ENV=test mix coveralls.json test/zaq/engine/connect test/zaq/engine/connect_test.exs test/zaq/engine/connect_token_edge_cases_test.exs test/zaq/engine/connect_encryption_error_test.exs exit 0: 129 tests + 1 property, 0 failures. Changed application-file coverage: Connect 95.3% (184/193 relevant lines), Credential 100% (20/20), Grant 100% (24/24). Real PostgreSQL validation includes legacy upgrade/down/up and migration retry, DB defaults/CHECKs/FKs, org NULL uniqueness and Person slots across all statuses, distinct committed backend connection races, failed real down migration retaining revoked Person ciphertext, and config rollback guard. Canonical encryption missing/invalid-key errors, in-place reconnect and resource-lane compatibility verified. docs/services/engine.md and system-config.md document storage decisions and later issue boundaries. No implementation environment blocker; existing missing license_manager configuration notice is nonfatal. No commits/push/PR/worktree creation. Keep issue in_progress for user review/uncommitted delivery per request; no later issue started.
